    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">6、AI Excle：数据分析与整合</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>实操示例：月度客服工单数据清洗 + 自动报表</h1>
<div>
<h2>1.实操背景</h2>
</div>
<div>
<div>原始 Excel 包含 6 月 12000 条客服工单数据，存在重复行、缺失班组信息、格式错乱，需统计各班组工单总量、平均处理时长、满意度均值并生成可视化图表。</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2>2.AI 自然语言指令（WPS AI 表格）</h2>
</div>
<div>
<p>（1）数据清洗指令：清除表格重复工单数据，填充空白班组字段为 “未分类”，标记处理时长＞48 小时异常工单；</p>
<p>（2）统计指令：按班组汇总工单总数量、平均处理时长、客户满意度平均分；</p>
<p>（3）可视化指令：生成柱状图对比各班组工单总量，折线图展示每日满意度波动。</p>
</div>
<div>
<h2>3.操作步骤</h2>
</div>
<div>
<p>（1）WPS 打开工单原始数据表，选中全部数据区域；</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="900" height="739" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712192317102-1949821762.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>（2）调出表格 AI，先执行清洗指令，自动规整原始数据；</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="874" height="465" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712201242003-1502580114.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;查看数据清洗的统计数据</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="665" height="2036" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712201346078-1722493215.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="802" height="441" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712201636736-446694147.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="917" height="607" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712201814794-1053124079.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>（3）下发统计指令，AI 自动生成 SUM、AVERAGEIFS 函数，输出汇总统计表；</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="1066" height="428" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712205215045-784521134.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712205625369-1377682939.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>（4）执行图表生成指令，自动生成商务风可视化图表；</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712205940332-1641930115.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712210942634-487992266.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>（5）AI 自动输出数据分析结论：XX 班组工单量最高、XX 班组满意度偏低；</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/869262/202607/869262-20260712205656421-1059123739.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>（6）人工修正异常数据解读，完成月度数据复盘报表。</p>
</div>

</div>
